title: C++ Decision Making
description: if/else, the ternary operator and switch, including fall-through and the classic assignment-in-condition trap.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: if/else、三元運算子與 switch，包括 fall-through 及在條件中誤用賦值的經典陷阱。

a.zh-Hant: 把 5 賦值給 x，然後測試 5（永遠為真）

b.zh-Hant: 比較 x 是否等於 5

d.zh-Hant: 把 x 與 5 相加

explanation.zh-Hant: `=` 是賦值而非比較；整個賦值運算式的值是 5，非零即為真，所以分支永遠進入。應寫 `x == 5`。

options.text: Assign 5 to x and then test 5, which is always true

questions.explanation: = is assignment, not comparison. The whole assignment expression has the value 5, which is non-zero and therefore true, so the branch always runs. Use `x == 5`.

questions.prompt: In a `switch`, what happens when a `case` block has no `break`?

prompt.zh-Hant: 在 `switch` 中，若某個 `case` 區塊沒有 `break`，會發生甚麼？

a.zh-Hant: 執行會繼續「落入」下一個 case

d.zh-Hant: 回到 switch 開頭重新判斷

explanation.zh-Hant: 沒有 break 時會 fall through，繼續執行下一個 case 的敘述，直到遇到 break 或 switch 結束。

options.text: Execution falls through into the next case
The compiler inserts a break automatically
The switch restarts from the top

questions.explanation: Without break, control falls through to the next case label and keeps executing until a break or the end of the switch.

questions.prompt: Which expression yields the larger of a and b using the conditional operator?

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一個運算式用條件運算子取得 a 與 b 中較大者？

explanation.zh-Hant: 條件成立（a > b）時回傳 a，否則回傳 b；其餘選項的語法或邏輯都不正確。

questions.explanation: If a > b the operator yields a, otherwise b. The other options have invalid syntax or return the smaller value.

questions.prompt: Which value makes `if (value)` take the false branch?

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一個值會讓 `if (value)` 進入 false 分支？

explanation.zh-Hant: 數值 0 轉為 bool 是 false；1 與 -1 都是 true，而字串字面值 "0" 的指標非空，也是 true。

questions.explanation: The integer 0 converts to false. Both 1 and -1 are true, and the string literal "0" decays to a non-null pointer, which is also true.

questions.prompt: Which types may be used as the controlling expression of a `switch`? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪些型別可以作為 `switch` 的控制運算式？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: switch 需要整數或列舉型別（可隱式轉為整數）；std::string 不是整數型別，不能直接用於 switch。

questions.explanation: A switch needs an integral or enumeration type (something implicitly convertible to an integer). std::string is not integral and cannot be switched on directly.

questions.prompt: Which statements about an `if / else if / else` chain are correct? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 關於 `if / else if / else` 鏈，下列敘述何者正確？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: 只有第一個成立的條件分支會執行。

b.zh-Hant: `else` 在沒有任何條件成立時執行。

c.zh-Hant: 條件的先後次序會影響結果。

d.zh-Hant: 所有成立的條件分支都會依序執行。

explanation.zh-Hant: if/else if 鏈從上到下檢查，第一個成立的分支執行後便跳過其餘分支；因此把較具體或較常見的條件放在前面很重要。

options.text: Only the first matching branch runs.
The order of the conditions can change the result.
Every matching branch runs in order.

questions.explanation: The chain is checked top to bottom; the first true condition runs and the rest are skipped. That is why ordering specific conditions before general ones matters.

questions.prompt: Each `case` label in a switch must be a compile-time constant expression.

prompt.zh-Hant: switch 中的每個 `case` 標籤都必須是編譯期常數運算式。

explanation.zh-Hant: case 標籤必須在編譯時已知且互不重複；執行期變數不能當作 case 值。

questions.explanation: Case labels must be known at compile time and must not duplicate each other. A run-time variable cannot be a case value.

questions.prompt: In `if (a) if (b) x(); else y();`, the `else` belongs to the inner `if`.

prompt.zh-Hant: 在 `if (a) if (b) x(); else y();` 中，`else` 屬於內層的 `if`。

explanation.zh-Hant: else 會與最近一個尚未配對的 if 結合，也就是內層 if (b)；用大括號可避免這種懸空 else 的混淆。

questions.explanation: An else binds to the nearest unmatched if, which is the inner `if (b)`. Braces make the intended pairing explicit and avoid the dangling-else trap.

questions.prompt: The `?:` operator is also called the ____ operator because it takes three operands.

prompt.zh-Hant: `?:` 運算子因為接受三個運算元，又稱為 ____ 運算子。

explanation.zh-Hant: 條件運算子是 C++ 唯一的三元運算子，形式為 condition ? a : b。

questions.explanation: The conditional operator is C++'s only ternary operator: condition ? a : b.

questions.prompt: Why is it recommended to put braces around every if/else body, even a single statement?

prompt.zh-Hant: 為何建議每個 if/else 本體都加大括號，即使只有一句？

explanation.zh-Hant: 大括號讓分支範圍明確，避免日後加句子時意外跑到分支外，也避免懸空 else 的誤讀。

model.zh-Hant: 大括號清楚界定分支的範圍。日後在分支中加一行時，不會因為忘記加括號而讓新句子跑到分支外；同時也讓懸空 else 的配對一目了然。

answer.model: Braces make the extent of the branch explicit. If a statement is added later without braces, it can silently fall outside the branch, and the dangling-else pairing becomes harder to read.

questions.explanation: Braces prevent a later edit from changing control flow by accident and make the branch boundaries obvious.
